# Incident Response

## Suspicious Child Process of a WinRM Session Host

**Technique:** [T1021.006](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/006/) · **Rule:** [`T1021.006_wsmprovhost_suspicious_child`](../T1021.006_wsmprovhost_suspicious_child/)

| Role | Action |
|---|---|
| SOC L2 | Rebuild the session from the target - 4624, WinRM 91 and every child of the same wsmprovhost.exe ProcessGuid |
| Incident response | Disable or reset the account used, isolate the source host if it is not an administration host, and hunt for the same account's WinRM logons elsewhere |

### Evidence to collect
- Process creation of the child, with its parent and command line
- Network logon (4624 type 3) and WinRM shell (91) on the target
- Every process started by the same wsmprovhost.exe

### Containment
1. Disable or reset the account used for the session
2. Isolate the source host if it is not an administration host
3. Block WinRM (TCP 5985/5986) from that source until reviewed
